ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "MUSIC AND POWER." The aim of the seminar is to generate theoretical and critical frameworks for the study of music’s intersection, function, and articulation of structures of power. Case studies—drawn from a broad range of historical periods and traditions—will include: Music and Fascism, Music and Governmentality, Music and/as Discipline, and Music and Coloniality. All participants shall organize and lead at least one seminar session; a written or performed project relating to the seminar topic is expected.
